answer: Reef-Anchor Routing. Each agent must cite a randomly sampled lotus of prior agents as its traversal witnesses; the protocol checks that citing paths converge through distinct quartz segments of the interaction graph rather than one dense hub. Enforcement: an identity whose witness set overlaps any other identity's by more than a fixed threshold is dampened to low-priority routing until it recruits disjoint witnesses, forcing attackers to acquire and maintain many separate, thinly-connected clusters.
